overview: From 2026-01-27 to 2026-01-28, ethereum-optimism/optimism had 6 new PRs (8 merged), 3 new issues, and 22 active contributors.

topIssues.title: Remove `SystemConfig::isCustomGasToken` override allowance for OPCMv2
topIssues.author: 0xiamflux
topIssues.body: OPCMv2 currently has an allowance that permits an override for the value of `SystemConfig::isCustomGasToken`. This is required until U18 ships when `isCustomGasToken` will be available on the SystemConfig and needs to be removed afterward.

topIssues.title: Migrate op-reth `optimism` crates into monorepo
topIssues.author: sebastianst
topIssues.body:
Follow pattern of migrating kona into monorepo https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18569

- checkout optimism crates from reth main branch to ensure intact git blame
- checkout out workspace manifest from reth and fix so reth deps point to reth git main branch or latest reth version on crates.io
- verify that git commit descriptions that link issues, link to the reth repo

topIssues.title: op-proposer: Support fetching proposals via op-supernode
topIssues.author: Inphi
topIssues.body:
The op-proposer currently fetches super root proposals exclusively through op-supervisor RPCs. We need to add support for fetching proposals via op-supernode as well, since supernode will eventually replace supervisor for this functionality.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
 
Rather than add a new CLI flag to support supernode endpoints, for now let's implement this as a config option in the op-proposer's API. This is enough to test this feature in devstack.

topIssues.title: op-alloy: Fix EIP-1559 params decoding
topIssues.author: sebastianst
topIssues.body:
Following up on #18625 we also want to properly catch zero elasticities during eip1559 params decoding. The best place to catch this is at the op-alloy level, so decoding fails early.

Related Go Stack PRs:
- https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18638
- https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/743

Partial fix in op-reth:
- https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/20858

topIssues.title: op-reth: Set up release flow
topIssues.author: sebastianst
topIssues.body: We need to set up a release flow for op-reth, ideally close to the release flow of other Go components.

topPRs.title: feat(ci): refactor circleci configs
topPRs.author: theochap
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Refactors CircleCI configuration by extracting shared Rust CI logic into a common `rust-ci.yml` template
- Simplifies individual project CI configs (`alloy-op-evm`, `alloy-op-hardforks`, `kona`, `op-alloy`, `op-reth`) by reusing the shared template
- Adds `justfile` targets for `alloy-op-evm`, `alloy-op-hardforks`, and `op-reth`; updates `op-alloy` Justfile
- Fix the API triggers for the individual rust jobs (ensure that we can trigger rust jobs through the API correctly)

## Test plan
- [x] Verify CircleCI pipeline triggers correctly on each sub-project
- [x] Confirm shared `rust-ci.yml` jobs run as expected
- [x] Check that justfile commands work locally for each project

Should close https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18927?issue=ethereum-optimism%7Coptimism%7C18928
